startCommonAppsAI();
$( document ).ready(function() { (async () => { let cont_complete=0;
while(startCommonAppsAIVars.pi_user_id == "" || startCommonAppsAIVars.pi_user_code == "") { await delayAsync(1000);
cont_complete+=1;
if(cont_complete >= 20 || (startCommonAppsAIVars.pi_user_id != "" && startCommonAppsAIVars.pi_user_code != "")) break; }
if(startCommonAppsAIVars.pi_user_id != "" && startCommonAppsAIVars.pi_user_code != "") { const STORAGE_KEYS_COMPLETED = { NICK: 'nexus_irc_nick', USERNAME: 'nexus_irc_username' }; let completed = 0; try { if(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS_COMPLETED.NICK) != startCommonAppsAIVars.pi_user_code) { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS_COMPLETED.NICK, startCommonAppsAIVars.pi_user_code); completed += 1; } } catch (e) {}
if(completed >= 1) window.location.reload(true); } })(); });

External WebIRC Gateways (Libera.Chat & OFTC) ✕
NEXUS//IRC connects directly via native browser WebSockets (wss://) to IRCv3 networks like Ergo and UnrealIRCd. Legacy TCP-only networks like Libera.Chat and OFTC require their own dedicated WebIRC proxy origins. You can launch their official crypto channels below or connect any wss:// bouncer (ZNC/Soju/Ergo) in Server Settings:
